So, I use a TV for a monitor through VGA. But it's a bit funny. The native resolution doesn't fit the screen and it causes all other display modes to not fit as well. I now have a new Nvidia graphics card and it's setting the native or max resolution to 1440x900 which doesn't fit my screen and causing every other display mode to not scale either. Is there a way I can set the max resolution to one of my choosing like I could with the catalyst control center on the Nvdia control panel? sorry for the long read. Just though a good explanation might help.

Problem with my display scaling. Can anyone help?

Dig around for your tv manufacturers support site and see if they have a driver for your tv. My girlfriends old Westinghouse panel wouldn't display right until i did this. Native resolution turned out to be 1366x768 but that wasn't available without the driver.

Under the Nvidia control panel on the left side menu go to the display menu and then to adjust desktop size and position there will be a drop down for "perform scaling on" and set it from monitor to gpu.
